思っていたより効果が普通でした、
リピートするかはまだわかりません。
reviews.zh: 比想像中效果普通，暫時未知會唔會回購。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Watergel Sheet Ampoule Mask Sheet 5ea
reviews.text: These do moisturise very well, but they do not fit my face well and I have to cut out the eyes more and around the nose, or else they end up falling into my eyes. Slips down unless you are completely laying on your back. Not sure if I will repurchase because it is such a hassle for me personally.
reviews.zh: 呢啲保濕效果真係好好，但唔啱我塊面，我要剪多啲眼窩位同鼻翼位，否則成塊 mask 會跌入我對眼。除非完全平瞓喺度，否則會滑落嚟。對我嚟講真係好麻煩，所以都唔知會唔會回購。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Watergel Sheet Ampoule Mask Sheet 5ea
reviews.text: I am obsessed! Absolutely love this mask! It is very hydrating and calming. If you have a compromised skin barrier and your skin is freaking out this is a safe sheet mask option that won’t irritate your skin.
reviews.zh: 我完全迷上咗！絕對鍾意呢塊 mask！好保濕好舒緩。如果你皮膚屏障受損、喺度爆發緊，呢塊 sheet mask 係安全嘅選擇，唔會刺激你嘅皮膚。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Watergel Sheet Ampoule Mask Sheet 5ea
reviews.text:
I’ve been really impressed with these sheet masks from Olive Young. The moment I put one on, it feels instantly soothing and refreshing on the skin. The essence is lightweight but still deeply hydrating, and it absorbs beautifully without leaving any sticky residue.
After using it, my skin looks noticeably calmer, more plump, and has a healthy glow. I also love that the mask fits well and doesn’t slip around, which makes it easy to relax while wearing it.
It’s gentle enough for sensitive skin and didn’t cause any irritation, which is a big plus for me. I’ve used several different types, and each one leaves my skin feeling soft, nourished, and well cared for.
Overall, this is a great addition to any skincare routine, especially when your skin needs extra hydration or a little reset. I’ll definitely keep repurchasing.
reviews.zh:
Olive Young 呢啲 sheet mask 真係令我好深刻。一敷上面，即刻覺得舒緩又清爽。精華好輕透但仍然深層保濕，而且吸收得好靚，唔會留低任何黐立立嘅感覺。
用完之後，我塊皮膚明顯無咁泛紅，望落更加飽滿，有健康光澤。我亦都好鍾意塊 mask 好貼面，唔會周圍滑，敷住嚟放鬆好方便。
佢夠溫和，敏感肌都用得，冇引起任何刺激，對我嚟講係一個大優點。我試過幾款唔同嘅，每一款都用完之後覺得皮膚軟熟、滋潤、被好好照顧。
整體嚟講，呢個係任何護膚程序嘅好幫手，尤其係你塊皮膚需要額外保濕或者少少 reset 嘅時候。我一定會繼續回購。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Watergel Sheet Ampoule Mask Sheet 5ea
reviews.text: This sheet mask calms irritation and gives skin a plump and glowy finish without irritation. This sheet mask is made with soft cellulose fabric!
reviews.zh: 呢塊 sheet mask 可以舒緩刺激，令皮膚有飽滿有光澤嘅妝效，唔會刺激皮膚。呢塊 sheet mask 係用柔軟嘅纖維布造嘅！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Watergel Sheet Ampoule Mask Sheet 5ea
reviews.text: Favorite sheet mask! Only con is it's hard to get laid flat on my face, but there's so much product on the sheet (and leftover in the pouch that I save) that it makes up for that. Moisturizes so well and leaves my skin so glowy. Adhesion gets better after 2 minutes and some product soaks in.
reviews.zh: 最鍾意嘅 sheet mask！唯一缺點係好難完全貼平我塊面，但塊 mask 上有好多產品（埋我儲起嘅袋入面剩低嘅），所以都仲係好滿意。保濕效果好到爆，而且皮膚變得好有光澤。等 2 分鐘精華吸收少少之後會更加貼面。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Watergel Sheet Ampoule Mask Sheet 5ea
reviews.text: An excellent-quality product! It has a very pleasant scent, an amazing texture, and provides great hydration. The product offers many benefits – it is very gentle, suitable for sensitive skin and for all ages. The packaging is convenient and well-designed. The size is great, and using it twice a week is more than enough, although I personally use it more frequently. It feels very comfortable on the skin and has become a permanent part of my routine. Overall, a fantastic product that I highly recommend!
reviews.zh: 質素極高嘅產品！有好香嘅味道、超正嘅質地，保濕效果一流。呢個產品有好多好處——好溫和，適合敏感肌同所有年齡層。包裝方便又設計得好好。Size 都好理想，一星期用兩次已經好足夠，不過我自己用得密啲。搽上皮膚好舒服，已經成為我日常必備嘅一部分。整體嚟講，係一款我高度推薦嘅超讚產品！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Watergel Sheet Ampoule Mask Sheet 5ea
reviews.text: This was another repurchase for me, i love love LOVE this mask for calming down my skin and moisturizing. The material is thin but still holds a lot of essence and clings to the face well once it dries a bit. If you put it on and start moving around right away it is a bit slippery. Mask fits well and the packages hold a lot of essence. Has become a go-to mask in my skincare routine
reviews.zh: 呢個係我再一次回購嘅，我勁勁勁鍾意呢塊 mask 用嚟舒緩皮膚同保濕。塊 mask 質地薄但仍然承載好多精華，乾少少先更加貼面。如果你一敷上面就周圍郁，會有少少滑。Mask 幾貼面，而且包裝入面有好多精華。已經成為我護膚程序嘅必備。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
